items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And tell Stan, it's too bad he wasn't here to get a piece of this pie.

ctx.x: That's nice, that's nice. It's a pleasure to do, isn't it? Yeah. It's a pleasure to do, it really is. It's fun, to go back and see what was what and look it all over and weigh it up.
And tell Stan, it's too bad he wasn't here to get a piece of this pie.
I'm going to bring him a piece of pie.
